svg.text: LE-01 · Sheet 3/3 · HOW THE BRAIDED ATTACHMENT IS MADE — step by step
Bellowerk Manufaktur · v2.0 · 18 Sep 2026 · A3 landscape · The three strands are coloured only to make them easy to follow — it is ONE piece of leather.
The same attachment is used at all five positions: hook A, ring 1, ring 2, and ring 3 + hook B together. Binding dimensions are on sheet 1 and sheet 2.
Strands of the same strap:
strand 1
strand 2
strand 3
Brass = ring / hook eye · red arrow = the next move

g.text: Crossing 1 — top strand over the middle

svg.text: 115 mm
Two lengthwise slits over 115 mm divide the 20 mm strap into
three strands of 6.7 mm. Slit ends punched Ø 2 mm so they
cannot tear. The strap is NEVER cut through.
fold back 150 mm
Pass the end through the ring (at hook B: through ring 3 AND
the hook eye) and fold it back on itself by 150 mm. From here
on every strand is TWO layers thick — braid them as one.
strand 1 over strand 2
Start the braid: bring the TOP strand over the middle one.
Keep the two layers of each strand flat and together, grain
side out. Pull every crossing tight before the next one.
strand 3 over the new middle
Now the BOTTOM strand crosses over the middle. Repeat these
two moves alternately — this is an ordinary 3-strand braid,
top over middle, bottom over middle.
the strap below twists up
pass the tail up through here
After every 2 crossings the strap below the braid twists,
because both ends are attached. Clear it: push the free tail
UP THROUGH the opening. The twist disappears — braid on.
115 mm · 9–10 crossings
Braid to 115 mm, then stop. The tail lies FLAT on the inside;
one Chicago screw 10 mm after the braid, tail trimmed 20 mm
after the screw, edge bevelled. Braid tight — it carries the load.
What each fold has to capture — the three positions on the lead
Hook A — hook eye only
Braid points towards the middle of the lead.
Ring 1 and ring 2 — ring on a bight
ONE continuous strap. Braid on the hook-B side.
lead continues
lead continues
Ring 3 + hook B — both in ONE fold
Ring centre 30 mm before the hook eye.
The knot on the sample
On the golden sample rings 1 and 2 are held by a
knot: the end is pulled through a slit in itself.
DO NOT COPY. Every ring on our lead is
braided as shown above — no knots at all.
